rationale: The agent performed multiple write actions (updating shipping addresses for two orders, updating the default user address, and exchanging the tablet) without any visible prior confirmation from the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is also unclear—only a lookup by email/user ID is shown, which does not demonstrate proper user authentication per policy. Additionally, the user asked to fix the single wrong-order address and the default address; the agent changed both pending orders’ addresses, which exceeds the user’s request. There is no evidence the agent validated that the replacement tablet was the cheapest before making the exchange. Given these issues, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
